ItemID: 1; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add streaming to my TV, though my 720p set would not benefit from 4K.
ItemID: 2; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in accessories for my existing devices than adding a smart display right now.
ItemID: 3; Title: Anker 4-Port USB 3.0 Ultra Slim Data Hub for Macbook, Mac Pro/mini, iMac, Surface Pro, XPS, Notebook PC, USB Flash Drives, Mobile HDD, and More; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Extra USB ports would be useful when connecting my card reader and other USB accessories.
ItemID: 4; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I regularly buy memory cards, and this familiar capacity and included adapter fit my storage needs.
ItemID: 5; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A voice-controlled speaker does not address an immediate need in my current device setup.
ItemID: 6; Title: Cat 6 Ethernet Cable 1 Ft (6Pack), Outdoor&Indoor, 10Gbps Support Cat7 Network, Heavy Duty Flat Internet LAN Patch Cord, Solid High Speed Weatherproof Cable for Router, Modem, Xbox, PS4, Switch, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no immediate use for six very short Ethernet cables.
ItemID: 7; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My camera accessory purchases do not translate into a current need for a home surveillance system.
ItemID: 8; Title: Amazon Basics 2-Pack USB-A 3.0 Extension Cable, 4.8Gbps High-Speed, Male to Female Gold-Plated Connectors, 6 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I buy practical cables, and these would give my USB accessories more reach.
ItemID: 9; Title: TOZO T10 Bluetooth 5.3 Wireless Earbuds with Wireless Charging Case IPX8 Waterproof Stereo Headphones in Ear Built in Mic Headset Premium Sound with Deep Bass for Sport White (2022 Upgraded); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for earbuds right now; storage and connection accessories are more relevant.
ItemID: 10; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire 7 and would need a specific reason to replace it with a larger tablet.
